Every pane's refresh and back buttons now have a key.

- `r` refreshes `/desk-pr`, `/desk-diff`, `/desk-context` and both desk-slack views, as it already did in the sessions, preview and Asana panes
- `b` goes back: task details in `/desk-tasks`, a task or project in desk-asana, a conversation or thread in desk-slack
- `v` opens the base picker (`vs <base> ⌄`) in `/desk-diff`'s `Branch` and `Commits` scopes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
